instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Core is a B2B SaaS platform providing comprehensive field service management solutions, including scheduling, dispatching, and mobile work order execution. They serve over 600 customers across the HVAC, plumbing, and electrical trades, currently processing 2 million work orders annually. The company maintains a solid ARR growth rate of 40%, focusing on integrating predictive analytics into their existing operational workflow.
answers.pastInitiatives: The team successfully deployed IoT sensors across 40% of production equipment, which resulted in a measurable 15% reduction in unplanned downtime. While this pilot proved the concept for asset monitoring, integrating these physical data streams seamlessly with their legacy maintenance system has revealed significant technical debt and integration complexity.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is achieving $50M ARR within five years by expanding market share and diversifying revenue through advanced recurring service packages. This requires the company to establish a scalable enterprise sales motion and successfully transition pricing from transactional service calls to high-value predictive subscription models.
answers.additionalContext: The internal innovation function operates with minimal dedicated resources, relying heavily on the senior engineer's discretionary time and existing operational slack. There is currently a strong organizational desire to innovate but lacks formalized processes for prioritizing and funding non-core projects.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

opportunities.title: AI Route Optimization Module Refinement
opportunities.rationale: Focusing on immediate optimization of the existing route planning tool will yield quick, measurable efficiency gains and satisfy short-term growth targets. This leverages current R&D efforts and directly impacts customer operational costs.

first_actions: Conduct a 1-week sprint dedicated to refining algorithms based on quarterly customer route data.
Develop an internal proof-of-concept for dynamic, real-time rescheduling during peak demand hours.
execution_plan.success_metric: 10% reduction in average driver idle time across pilot routes within 3 months.
milestones: Month 2: Beta rollout to 5 enterprise customers

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Predictive Maintenance Platform (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Instead of simply monitoring utilization, developing a radical AI module that combines IoT sensor data with historical maintenance logs and external weather patterns to provide prescriptive, hyper-local failure alerts for specific equipment is a high-leverage differentiator. This moves the product from descriptive analytics to autonomous action.

first_actions: Hire/Contract one specialist focused purely on Machine Learning model training (3 months).
Establish a dedicated cross-functional 'AI Spike' team with budget allocation.
resources_needed: Dedicated engineering time commitment (1 FTE equivalent)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieving 90% predictive accuracy for critical equipment failure alerts.
milestones: Month 3: MVP Model trained and validated
Month 6: Integration into core platform with functional UI/UX.

opportunities.title: Vertical-Specific Industry Niche Expansion
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging dedicated customer feedback to build a specialized module tailored for one trade (e.g., heavy industrial HVAC) allows the company to demonstrate deep domain expertise and command premium pricing, fueling revenue growth.

first_actions: Identify top 3 industry verticals based on ARR/complexity data.
Develop a lightweight 'Industry Vertical Accelerator' feature for one selected vertical.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 25% adoption rate within the target industry niche in Q4.
milestones: Month 6: Positive feedback and initial revenue spike.

next_steps.action: Formalize an 'Innovation Portfolio' and allocate a fixed, ring-fenced budget ($30k) specifically for high-risk/high-reward radical projects.
Initiate the 'AI Spike' project to prototype the Hyper-Personalized Predictive Maintenance Platform, securing necessary technical resources immediately.
Establish monthly cross-departmental innovation reviews to better integrate the 'partial' process with product development cycles.

key_weaknesses: Owner-alone decision-making leading to resource bottlenecks and inconsistent strategic direction.
Limited innovation budget (17%) constraining experimentation beyond immediate operational needs.
Informal innovation culture where high-value R&D is frequently sidelined by urgent feature requests.
High technical debt in legacy systems hindering the seamless integration of new IoT and AI modules.
